summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without running any tests or repository code. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 format entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title classmethod; rich/console.py adds set_window_title gated only on is_terminal, returning True when written and False otherwise; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a legacy dispatch branch calling term.set_title(title). Tests added in tests/test_console.py (skips assertion on legacy Windows), tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only). CHANGELOG.md gained an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200. Nothing was committed. Verification was by reading only; the tests have not been run.
